title: 可操控多元对齐中的目标冲突预测与权衡覆盖
summary: 研究MODPO中目标权重如何平衡竞争目标：两个预训练指标可预测人类标注数据的目标对齐或冲突，但在AI标注数据中受长度与重复干扰；模型选择与参数合并可扩大权衡覆盖，但均不如直接训练。
summary_en: Studies when one model can improve two objectives simultaneously and how to cover many trade-offs without training separate models. Two pre-training measurements predict objective alignment/conflict for human-annotated data but not AI-annotated data, where length and repetition confound reward scores. Nearest-model selection and parameter merging help coverage but do not consistently match direct training.
